title: bootBuildImage 'Invalid buildpack reference' on Apple Silicon with Docker Desktop
errorSample:
Execution failed for task ':bootBuildImage'.
> Invalid buildpack reference '<buildpack>'
Caused by: org.springframework.boot.buildpack.platform.docker.transport.DockerEngineException: Docker API call to 'docker://localhost/images/docker.io/paketobuildpacks/opentelemetry:2/get' failed with status code 404 "Not Found" and message "unable to create manifests file: NotFound: content digest sha256:c7ee7bde14d2...: not found"
symptom: bootBuildImage fails with "Invalid buildpack reference" and a DockerEngineException with status 404 Not Found when an external buildpack such as paketobuildpacks/opentelemetry:2 is configured.
cause: The plugin talks to the default Docker socket location, but Docker Desktop on macOS keeps its socket under the user's home directory, so some requests reach a stale daemon context. In addition the anonymous registry pull of the buildpack image is refused or throttled and the daemon's 'not found' answer is surfaced as an invalid reference.
fixSummary: Point the plugin at the Desktop socket with docker { host = "unix:///Users/<name>/.docker/run/docker.sock" } (or DOCKER_HOST), enable the default Docker socket option in Docker Desktop settings, run docker login for the registry, and set docker.builderRegistry credentials in the plugin configuration.
